text:
emma_ml: Quick heads-up — the new zephyr-int8 canary is producing truncated JSON arrays when outputs exceed ~2k tokens.
raj_s: Repro steps?
emma_ml: run `./canary.sh --model zephyr-int8 --schema toolcalls.ndjson` and POST to /eval. snippet below.
leah_w: we saw a similar pattern with kvprefix bursts earlier — looks like a streaming chunk boundary cut inside an open array :thinking_face:
emma_ml: log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-20T22:12:43Z] OUT: {"tool":"search","args":[{"q":"query1"},
{"q":"query2"}   <-- stream cut here
```
raj_s: ugh. boundary split array elements. Could be the streamer sending chunk with partial UTF-8 or tokenized byte split.
leah_w: quick mitigation idea: emit a tiny sentinel just before `[` (array start) like `` so downstream can reassemble if chunking happens. low perf cost.
emma_ml: +1 to sentinel. also add a conservative parser-backup that joins lines and tries `json.loads` with a tolerant mode before running heuristic repairs. Keep it toggled off by default for baseline.
sre-bot: deploy-canary job queued: zephyr-int8-canary-sentinel -> starts 02:00 UTC :rocket:
raj_s: I'll add generator change and unit tests (emit sentinel + decode strip). will also add a targeted fuzz test that forces chunk splits mid-array.
leah_w: please also add telemetry event `parse.sentinel_repair` so we can measure how often repair fires vs true model regression.
emma_ml: timeline: patch & tests today, canary snapshot tomorrow AM. if failure rate > 0.5% revert canary and roll back to fp32 baseline.
raj_s: noted. keeping the repair toggle feature-flagged.
leah_w: thanks — let's avoid heavy postprocess heuristics permanently; sentinel lets us be surgical. :thumbsup:
